interpreterSource.note: Built with ./build-wasm.sh on Linux x86_64 (rust 1.97.1). Testnet only: this is the grammar-7 interpreter whose read-only `check` entry point always ends in a contract error carrying the verdict (0 permits), so a submitted `check` commits nothing. It replaces the first build (CDL7KHDKR7GZ2UN4P2XVJ63JTULNK3G5XKCE5NYKTMKKYONOAEKB3ZTB, wasm eb1ec6ee...), whose `check` returned a value and so could commit a `read`'s side effects; that contract is still deployed and the builder refuses it. No mainnet deployment, and nothing else deployed was touched.

note: Grammar 7 interpreter, testnet only. The deployer is a throwaway identity funded by friendbot. The pin in packages/policy-synth/src/config.ts names this address.

liveTests.note: An OZ smart account (rule 0: Default, no policy, one delegated signer: the deployer) used by packages/policy-synth's live tests. Rule 1 was installed on the previous interpreter build (previousInstallTx), so it reads as a rule policed by a known interpreter this build refuses to trust; rule 2 was installed through the builder on the current interpreter (installTx): an interpreter predicate scoped to a made-up token contract. The recorded RPC fixtures (packages/policy-synth/fixtures/rpc) replay against this account.
